title: Pip and the Four Colors
learning_goal: Recognize and name red, yellow, blue and green.
takeaway: Colors are all around us, and we can find and name them.

style_bible.art_style: flat 2D vector cartoon, soft rounded shapes, thick clean outlines, storybook look
style_bible.lighting: soft daylight, warm and cheerful, no harsh shadows

characters.name: Pip
characters.description: Pip, a small round puppy with cream fur, big floppy brown ears, one brown patch over the left eye, a red neckerchief, large friendly eyes, always smiling

music: gentle ukulele and soft xylophone, cheerful, about 100 bpm, loops smoothly
voice: warm, friendly young female voice, slow and clear, smiling tone, small pause after each question

publishing.title: Learn 4 Colors with Pip the Puppy 🐶 Red, Yellow, Blue, Green
publishing.description: Join Pip the puppy on a sunny walk and learn four colors: red, yellow, blue and green. For ages 3-5. Made with AI-assisted illustration and voice; original story and characters.
publishing.thumbnail_idea: Pip holding a big red apple, smiling at the viewer, with yellow, blue and green circles floating behind him

scenes.setting: sunny meadow with three tall sunflowers
scenes.visual: Pip stands in the middle of the meadow and waves at the camera
scenes.action: Pip waves one paw and smiles
scenes.narration: Hello, friends! I am Pip. Let's find colors today!
scenes.sound: soft happy intro jingle, then music under the voice

scenes.setting: sunny meadow with an apple tree
scenes.visual: Pip points at a big shiny red apple hanging on a branch
scenes.action: Pip points at the apple and tilts his head
scenes.narration: Look! A red apple. Red, red, red! Can you say red?
scenes.sound: small pop sound when the apple appears; pause after the question

scenes.setting: open meadow with a big bright sun in the sky
scenes.visual: Pip looks up at a big yellow sun with a friendly face
scenes.action: Pip shades his eyes with one paw and smiles
scenes.camera: gentle tilt up from Pip to the sky
scenes.narration: Yellow is the sun. Yellow, yellow, yellow!

scenes.setting: calm blue sky with two fluffy white clouds
scenes.visual: Pip lies on his back on the grass looking at the blue sky
scenes.narration: Blue is the sky. Blue, blue, blue!

scenes.setting: green grass field with small flowers
scenes.visual: Pip sits on bright green grass and pats it with his paw
scenes.action: Pip pats the grass and looks at the viewer
scenes.narration: Green is the grass. Green, green, green! Can you find something green?
scenes.sound: gentle rustle; 2 seconds of silence after the question

scenes.setting: meadow with a little green frog on a lily pad in a pond
scenes.visual: Pip and a small green frog look at each other happily
scenes.action: The frog hops once and Pip laughs
scenes.narration: A green frog! You found it!

scenes.setting: cream background with four large colored circles in a row
scenes.visual: Four big circles in red, yellow, blue and green appear one after another, Pip stands beside them
scenes.action: Pip points to each circle in turn
scenes.narration: Red, yellow, blue, and green! Let's count our colors: one, two, three, four!
scenes.sound: one soft note for each circle

scenes.setting: sunny meadow with three tall sunflowers
scenes.visual: Pip jumps happily with a small rainbow of confetti in the air
scenes.narration: Wow! You did it! Goodbye, friends!
scenes.sound: happy cheer, music resolves and fades
